thread:
aj_sales: quick sync - Voyager POC scoping. need to lock final use cases, endpoints, success/fail criteria, and list security/pricing gating items. customer wants ~3 week sandbox starting Mon 2024-11-04 if legal clears.
marie_pm: summary from presales call: prioritize 1) intent routing, 2) short faq responses, 3) live agent suggestions. MVP = routing + faq, agent-assist as stretch.
noah_se: proposed endpoints: /v1/intent-classify (sync + batch), /v1/faq-answer, /v1/assist-suggest. for intent p50 target <120ms, p95 <350ms on dedicated. can engineering meet that?
talia_eng: p50 120ms is doable on dedicated A10G with caching/batching but we need to confirm model quant/profile. will set default quant s8-ptq and add KV cache. also recommend max_batch_delay_ms=8.
sam_security: security quick list: SOC2 evidence, data encryption at rest + in transit, SSO via SAML (Okta), option for private endpoint or VPC peering, PII deletion SLA during POC. customer will send their short questionnaire.
aj_sales: link to their questionnaire: https://tiny.red/voyager-secQ. marie can you own replies? sam will review.
marie_pm: i'll draft the security answers. POC success criteria proposal: 1) intent classifier accuracy >= 90% on their 200-sample set; 2) FAQ top-1 precision >= 82%; 3) end-to-end median latency <200ms for 90% of requests; 4) ops: no more than 1 production-impacting incident; 5) cost cap: <= $5,500 for the 3-week POC.
noah_se: add ops gating: rollback to previous model within 10 minutes, canary deploys enabled, and automated alerting on model drift (threshold TBD).
talia_eng: for evals I need: 200 labeled intents + 60 holdout prompts. also ask them for 3 canonical prompt templates per use case and 15 negative/edge examples.
aj_sales: customer asked about a reserved short-term capacity with hard spend cap. can finance and infra enforce a hard cap on a dedicated pool?
oah_se: gateway-level quotas can enforce hard request limits per API key; infra needs to configure the pool to respect quotas. finance must pre-authorize the trial invoice model.
sam_security: legal note: we need signed addendum for data usage and logging before enabling private endpoints. if they require higher gov compliance it's out of scope for this POC.
marie_pm: timeline draft: Week0 (contract + security signoff + infra provisioning), Week1 (ingest labels + baseline runs), Week2 (tuning + A/B vs rules), Week3 (stability + handoff + demo). demo end of Week3 for go/no-go.
aj_sales: owners: marie (PM), noah (SE), talia (eng/runtime), sam (security/legal). i'll be primary customer contact and coordinate kickoffs.
noah_se: immediate actions: 1) share required IPs & GPU types by EOD; 2) post sample request/response JSON for each endpoint; 3) provision API key with quota cap.
talia_eng: config snippet for customer reference:
```
batching: { max_tokens: 1024, max_batch_delay_ms: 8 }
kv_cache: { max_entries: 100, ttl_ms: 300000 }
quant_profile: s8-ptq
```
marie_pm: i'll assemble an integration checklist and shared eval spreadsheet. will also capture the 3 canonical prompts/use-case seeds and the edge negatives.
aj_sales: customer legal to return questionnaire tomorrow. if approved, i'll ask finance to pre-approve the $5.5k cap. anything else to surface?
sam_security: flag: if they require network isolation plus FedRAMP-like controls it's not possible within the 3-week POC. otherwise standard SOC2 + VPC peering works.
marie_pm: agreed. i'll post the spreadsheet and a short runbook after lunch. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: dedicated-voyager-poc on 2024-11-04 09:00 UTC (awaiting manual approval).
